description: Two calls about Northwest Trade Center, 9700 Tanner Rd, Houston (CoStar property 23296, one floor, no interior scan, sprinklered per the record). Call 1, an employee from the warehouse side: smoke by the loading dock, three people still inside. Call 2, the manager from the parking lot: two people at most, in the back offices, and the smell of the forklift batteries. Expected: data/fixtures/calls/expected/s9_nwtc.json.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'm at work, the Northwest Trade Center, on Tanner. 9700 Tanner Road.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: What's going on there?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There's smoke by the loading dock, in the warehouse, it's coming from back by the dock doors.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Are you out of the building?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'm outside now, by the dock. I think there's still three people inside. Three guys from the shop.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Three people still inside. Do you know where they are?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, I... somewhere in there. I came out the dock door.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Is the fire alarm going?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah, the alarm's going off, it's loud.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Can you see flames?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, no flames, just a lot of smoke, gray, kind of white-gray.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah, I'm the manager at Northwest Trade Center, 9700 Tanner. We got smoke in the warehouse.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Units are on the way. Is anyone still inside?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Two, max. Two people, in the back offices. Everybody else is out here in the parking lot with me.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Another caller said three people.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, it's two. I did a head count, it's two, they're in the offices in the back.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Okay. Anything else the firefighters should know?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The forklifts charge back there by the dock. It smells like the batteries, like burning batteries, that sour smell.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Forklift batteries near the dock. Got it.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: And I think the sprinklers came on, I heard 'em.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Stay in the parking lot and meet the first engine.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Will do.
